verses.text: Dem tell David say, “Look, di Philistines dey fight against Keilah, and dem dey rob di threshing floors.”
So David enquire of di Lord say, “I go go and strike dis Philistines?” Di Lord talk to David say, “Go, strike di Philistines, and save Keilah.”
Di men of David talk to am say, “Look, we dey afraid here for Judah. How e go be den if we go to Keilah against di armies of di Philistines?”
Den David enquire of di Lord again. Di Lord answer am say, “Arise, go down to Keilah, because I go deliver di Philistines into your hand.”
David and im men go to Keilah, and fight with di Philistines, and carry away dem livestock, and strike dem with great slaughter. So David save di people of Keilah.
When Abiathar di pikin of Ahimelech flee to David to Keilah, e come down with one ephod for im hand.
Dem tell Saul say David don come to Keilah. Saul talk say, “God don deliver am into my hand, because e don shut imself in, by entering into one town wey get gates and bars.”
Saul summon all di people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and im men.
David know say Saul dey plan mischief against am, and e talk to Abiathar di priest say, “Bring di ephod here.”
Den David talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, your servant don hear for sure say Saul dey seek to come to Keilah, to destroy di city for my sake.
Di men of Keilah go deliver me up into im hand? Saul go come down, as your servant don hear? Di Lord, di God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” Di Lord talk say, “E go come down.”
Den David talk say, “Di men of Keilah go deliver me and my men into di hand of Saul?” Di Lord talk say, “Dem go deliver you up.”
Den David and im men, about 600, arise and depart out of Keilah, and go wherever dem fit go. Dem tell Saul say David don escape from Keilah, and e no go again.
David dey stay for di wilderness for di strongholds, and remain for di hill country for di wilderness of Ziph. Saul seek am every day, but God no deliver am into im hand.
David see say Saul don come out to seek im life, and David dey for di wilderness of Ziph for Horesh.
Jonathan, Saul pikin man, rise, and go to David for Horesh, and strengthen im hand for God.
E talk to am say, “No fear, because di hand of Saul my papa no go find you. You go be king over Israel, and I go be next to you, and Saul my papa know dat too.”
Di two of dem make covenant before di Lord. David stay for Horesh, and Jonathan go to im house.
Den di Ziphites go up to Saul to Gibeah, talk say, “David no dey hide imself with us for di strongholds for Horesh, for di hill of Hachilah, wey dey south of Jeshimon?
Now therefore, king, come down according to all di desire of your soul to come down, and our part go be to deliver am up into di king hand.”
Saul talk say, “Blessed be una of di Lord, because una don show compassion to me.
Go, I beg una, make more preparation, and know and see im place wia im foot dey, and who don see am dere. Because dem tell me say e dey deal very subtly.
See therefore, and know all di lurking places wia e hide imself, and come back to me with certainty, and I go go with una. If e dey for di land, I go search am out among all di thousands of Judah.”
Dem rise, and go to Ziph before Saul. But David and im men dey for di wilderness of Maon, for di Arabah on di south of Jeshimon.
Saul and im men go to seek am. Dem tell David, so e go down to di rock, and dwell for di wilderness of Maon. When Saul hear am, e pursue after David for di wilderness of Maon.
Saul go di one side of di mountain, and David and im men go di other side of di mountain. David hurry to get away for fear of Saul, because Saul and im men dey encircle David and im men to take dem.
But one messenger come to Saul, talk say, “Hurry and come, because di Philistines don invade di land.”
So Saul return from pursuing David, and go against di Philistines. Dis na why dem call dat place Sela Hammahlekoth.
David go up from dere, and dwell for di strongholds of En Gedi.
When Saul return from following di Philistines, dem tell am say, “Look, David dey for di wilderness of En Gedi.”
Saul take 3,000 chosen men out of all Israel, and go to seek David and im men upon di rocks of di wild goats.
E come to di sheepfolds by di way, wia one cave dey, and Saul go in to cover im feet. Now David and im men dey remain for di innermost parts of di cave.

Di men of David talk to am say, “Look, na di day wey di Lord talk to you say, ‘Look, I go deliver your enemy into your hand, and you go do to am as e seem good to you.’” Den David arise, and cut off di skirt of Saul robe secretly.
E happen afterward say David heart strike am, because e don cut off Saul skirt.
E talk to im men say, “Di Lord forbid say I go do dis thing to my oga, di Lord anointed, to stretch out my hand against am, seeing say na di Lord anointed e be.”
So David restrain im men with dem words, and no allow dem to rise against Saul. Saul rise up out of di cave, and go on im way.
David rise up afterward, and go out of di cave, and cry after Saul say, “My oga di king!” When Saul look behind am, David bow with im face to di earth, and make homage.
David talk to Saul say, “Why you dey listen to men wey talk say, ‘Look, David dey seek your harm’?

Look, dis day your eyes don see how di Lord don deliver you today into my hand for di cave. Some tell me to kill you, but my eye spare you, and I talk say, ‘I no go stretch out my hand against my oga, because e na di Lord anointed.’

Moreover, my papa, see, yes, see di skirt of your robe for my hand. Because I cut off di skirt of your robe, and no kill you, know and perceive say no evil or rebellion dey for my hand, and I no sin against you, though you hunt my soul to take am.
Make di Lord judge between me and you, and make di Lord avenge me of you, but my hand no go dey upon you.
As di proverb of di ancients talk say, ‘Wickedness dey come from di wicked,’ but my hand no go dey upon you.
After who di king of Israel don come out? After who you dey chase? After one dead dog, after one flea.
Make di Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
E happen, when David don finish speaking dem words to Saul, say Saul talk say, “Na your voice dis, my pikin man David?” Saul lift up im voice, and weep.
E talk to David say, “You dey more righteous pass me, because you don render me good, whereas I don render you evil.
You don show dis day how you don deal well with me, since di Lord deliver me up into your hand, and you no kill me.
Because if man find im enemy, e go send am go safe? So make di Lord reward you with good for wetin you don do to me dis day.
Now look, I know say you go surely be king, and say di kingdom of Israel go dey established for your hand.
Swear now therefore to me for di Lord, say you no go cut off my seed after me, and say you no go destroy my name out of my papa house.”
David swear to Saul. Saul go home, but David and im men go up to di stronghold.
Samuel die, and all Israel gather together, and mourn am, and bury am for im house for Ramah. David rise, and go down to di wilderness of Paran.
One man dey for Maon, wey im business dey for Carmel, and di man dey very great, and e get 3,000 sheep, and 1,000 goats. E dey shear im sheep for Carmel.
Di name of di man na Nabal, and di name of im wife na Abigail. Di woman dey of good understanding, and beautiful, but di man dey churlish and evil for im doings. E na Calebite.
David hear for di wilderness say Nabal dey shear im sheep.
David send out ten young men, and David talk to di young men say, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet am for my name.
Talk to am so: ‘Peace to you, and peace to your house, and peace to all wey you get.
Now I don hear say you get shearers. Your shepherds don dey with us, and we no hurt dem, and dem no miss anything all di time wey dem dey Carmel.

Ask your young men, and dem go tell you. So make di young men find favour for your eyes, because we come for good day. Give, I beg you, wetin dey your hand to your servants, and to your pikin man David.’”
When David young men come, dem talk to Nabal all dem words for David name, and stop.
Nabal answer David servants say, “Who be David? And who be di pikin of Jesse? Plenty servants dey nowadays wey break away every man from im oga.
Make I take my bread, and my water, and my meat wey I kill for my shearers, and give am to men wey I no know wia dem come from?”
So David young men turn on dem way, and go back, and come and tell am all dem words.
David talk to im men say, “Every man gird on im sword.” Every man gird on im sword. David also gird on im sword. About 400 men go up after David, and 200 stay with di baggage.
But one of di young men tell Abigail, Nabal wife, say, “Look, David send messengers out of di wilderness to greet our oga, and e rail at dem.
But di men dey very good to us, and we no dey hurt, and we no miss anything, all di time wey we waka with dem, when we dey for di fields.
Dem dey wall to us both by night and by day, all di time wey we dey with dem keeping di sheep.
Now therefore know and consider wetin you go do, because evil don dey determined against our oga, and against all im house, because e na wicked man, so tay nobody fit speak to am.”

Den Abigail hurry, and take 200 loaves, and two skins of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched grain, and 100 clusters of raisins, and 200 cakes of figs, and load dem on donkeys.
E talk to im young men say, “Go on before me. Look, I dey come after una.” But e no tell im husband Nabal.
E happen, as e ride on im donkey, and come down by di covert of di mountain, say look, David and im men dey come down toward am, and e meet dem.
Now David don talk say, “Surely na for nothing I don keep all wey dis man get for di wilderness, so tay nothing miss of all wey belong to am. E don return me evil for good.
God do so to David enemies, and more also, if I leave any male of all wey belong to am by morning light.”
When Abigail see David, e hurry, and alight from im donkey, and fall before David on im face, and bow imself to di ground.
E fall at im feet, and talk say, “On me, my oga, on me make di iniquity dey. Make your servant, I beg you, speak for your ears, and hear di words of your servant.
Make my oga no regard dis wicked man, Nabal, because as im name be, so e be. Nabal na im name, and folly dey with am. But I your servant no see di young men of my oga, wey you send.

Now therefore, my oga, as di Lord live, and as your soul live, since di Lord don withhold you from blood guiltiness, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now make your enemies, and dem wey seek evil to my oga, dey like Nabal.
Now dis present wey your servant don bring to my oga, make dem give am to di young men wey follow my oga.
Forgive di trespass of your servant, because di Lord go surely make my oga one sure house, because my oga dey fight di battles of di Lord, and evil no go dey find for you all your days.

Though man dey rise to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet di soul of my oga go dey bound for di bundle of life with di Lord your God, and di souls of your enemies, e go sling dem out, as from di middle of one sling.
E go happen, when di Lord don do to my oga according to all di good wey e don speak concerning you, and don appoint you prince over Israel,

say dis go no be grief to you, or offence of heart to my oga, both say you don shed blood without cause, and say my oga don avenge imself. When di Lord don deal well with my oga, den remember your servant.”
David talk to Abigail say, “Blessed be di Lord, di God of Israel, wey send you dis day to meet me.
Blessed be your discretion, and blessed be you, wey don keep me dis day from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.
For truly, as di Lord, di God of Israel, live, wey don keep me back from hurting you, if you no hurry and come to meet me, surely by morning light no male go remain to Nabal.”
So David receive from am wetin e bring, and talk to am say, “Go up in peace to your house. See, I don listen to your voice, and don accept your person.”

Abigail come to Nabal, and look, e hold one feast for im house, like di feast of one king. Nabal heart dey merry within am, because e dey very drunk. So e tell am nothing, small or great, until di morning light.
For di morning, when di wine don go out of Nabal, im wife tell am dem things, and im heart die within am, and e become like one stone.
About ten days after, di Lord strike Nabal, so e die.

When David hear say Nabal don die, e talk say, “Blessed be di Lord, wey don plead di cause of my reproach from di hand of Nabal, and don keep im servant from evil. Di Lord don return di wickedness of Nabal upon im own head.” David send and speak concerning Abigail, to take am as im wife.
When di servants of David come to Abigail to Carmel, dem speak to am, talk say, “David send us to you, to take you to am as wife.”
E arise, and bow imself with im face to di earth, and talk say, “Look, make your servant be one maid to wash di feet of di servants of my oga.”
Abigail hurry, and arise, and ride on one donkey, with five maids wey follow am. E follow di messengers of David, and become im wife.
David also take Ahinoam of Jezreel, and dem both be im wives.
Now Saul don give Michal im pikin woman, David wife, to Palti di pikin of Laish, wey dey from Gallim.
Di Ziphites come to Saul to Gibeah, talk say, “David no dey hide imself for di hill of Hachilah, wey dey before Jeshimon?”
Den Saul arise, and go down to di wilderness of Ziph, and 3,000 chosen men of Israel dey with am, to seek David for di wilderness of Ziph.
Saul camp for di hill of Hachilah, wey dey before Jeshimon, by di way. But David dey stay for di wilderness, and e see say Saul come after am into di wilderness.
David send out spies, and understand say Saul don come for sure.

David arise, and come to di place wia Saul camp, and David see di place wia Saul lie, and Abner di pikin of Ner, di captain of im army. Saul dey lie within di barricade, and di people camp round about am.
Den David answer Ahimelech di Hittite, and Abishai di pikin of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, say, “Who go go down with me to Saul for di camp?” Abishai talk say, “I go go down with you.”
So David and Abishai come to di people by night, and look, Saul lie sleeping within di barricade, with im spear stuck for di ground at im head, and Abner and di people lie round about am.
Den Abishai talk to David say, “God don deliver your enemy into your hand dis day. Now therefore make I strike am, I beg you, with di spear to di earth at once, and I no go strike am di second time.”
David talk to Abishai say, “No destroy am, because who fit stretch out im hand against di Lord anointed, and dey guiltless?”
David talk say, “As di Lord live, di Lord go strike am, or im day go come to die, or e go go down into battle, and perish.
Di Lord forbid say I go stretch out my hand against di Lord anointed. But now, I beg you, take di spear wey dey im head, and di jar of water, and make we go.”
So David take di spear and di jar of water from Saul head, and dem go away. Nobody see am, or know am, or wake, because dem all dey sleep, because one deep sleep from di Lord don fall upon dem.
Den David cross over to di other side, and stand on di top of di mountain far off, wey one great space dey between dem.
David cry to di people, and to Abner di pikin of Ner, say, “You no go answer, Abner?” Den Abner answer say, “Who you be wey cry to di king?”
David talk to Abner say, “You no be man? Who dey like you for Israel? Why den you no keep your oga di king? Because one of di people come in to destroy di king your oga.
Dis thing wey you don do no good. As di Lord live, una must die, because una no keep una oga, di Lord anointed. Now see wia di king spear dey, and di jar of water wey dey im head.”
Saul recognise David voice, and talk say, “Na your voice dis, my pikin man David?” David talk say, “Na my voice, my oga, king.”
E talk say, “Why my oga dey pursue im servant? Because wetin I don do? Or wetin evil dey for my hand?

Now therefore, I beg you, make my oga di king hear di words of im servant. If di Lord don stir you up against me, make am accept one offering, but if na di pikin dem of men, make dem cursed before di Lord, because dem don drive me out dis day from joining myself to di inheritance of di Lord, say, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
Now therefore, no make my blood fall to di earth away from di presence of di Lord, because di king of Israel don come out to seek one flea, as when man hunt one partridge for di mountains.”
Den Saul talk say, “I don sin. Return, my pikin man David, because I no go do you harm again, because my life dey precious for your eyes dis day. Look, I don play di fool, and don err exceedingly.”
David answer say, “Look, di spear, king! Make one of di young men come over and get am.
Di Lord go reward every man im righteousness and im faithfulness, because di Lord deliver you into my hand today, but I no go stretch out my hand against di Lord anointed.
Look, as your life dey precious dis day for my eyes, so make my life dey precious for di eyes of di Lord, and make e deliver me out of all tribulation.”
Den Saul talk to David say, “Blessed be you, my pikin man David. You go both do great things, and also go surely prevail.” So David go im way, and Saul return to im place.

David talk to im heart say, “Now I go perish one day by di hand of Saul. Nothing better for me than say I escape into di land of di Philistines. Saul go despair of me, to seek me again for all di borders of Israel, so I go escape out of im hand.”
David arise, and cross over, e and di 600 men wey dey with am, to Achish di pikin of Maoch, king of Gath.
David dwell with Achish for Gath, e and im men, every man with im household, David with im two wives, Ahinoam di Jezreelitess, and Abigail di Carmelitess, Nabal wife.
Dem tell Saul say David don flee to Gath, and e no seek am again.

David talk to Achish say, “If I don find favour for your eyes, make dem give me one place for one of di cities for di country, so that I go dwell dere, because why your servant go dwell for di royal city with you?”
Den Achish give am Ziklag dat day. Dis na why Ziklag belong to di kings of Judah to dis day.
Di number of di days wey David dwell for di country of di Philistines na one full year and four months.
David and im men go up, and raid di Geshurites, and di Girzites, and di Amalekites, because dem na di inhabitants of di land wey dey of old, as you go to Shur, even to di land of Egypt.
David strike di land, and leave neither man nor woman alive, and take away di sheep, and di oxen, and di donkeys, and di camels, and di clothing, and e return, and come to Achish.
Achish talk say, “Wia una don raid today?” David talk say, “Against di south of Judah, and against di south of di Jerahmeelites, and against di south of di Kenites.”
David leave neither man nor woman alive, to bring to Gath, talk say, “Make dem no tell on us say, ‘So David do, and so e don be im manner all di time wey e dey di country of di Philistines.’”
Achish believe David, talk say, “E don make im people Israel utterly abhor am, so e go be my servant forever.”
E happen for dat time say di Philistines gather dem armies together for war, to fight with Israel. Achish talk to David say, “Know surely say you go go out with me in di army, you and your men.”
David talk to Achish say, “Surely you go know wetin your servant go do.” Achish talk to David say, “Therefore I go make you keeper of my head forever.”
Now Samuel don die, and all Israel don mourn am, and bury am for Ramah, even for im own city. Saul don put away di mediums and di wizards out of di land.
Di Philistines gather together, and come and camp for Shunem. Saul gather all Israel together, and dem camp for Gilboa.
When Saul see di army of di Philistines, e dey afraid, and im heart tremble greatly.
When Saul enquire of di Lord, di Lord no answer am, either by dreams, or by Urim, or by prophets.

Den Saul talk to im servants say, “Seek me one woman wey get familiar spirit, so that I go go to am, and enquire of am.” Im servants talk to am say, “Look, one woman wey get familiar spirit dey for Endor.”

Saul disguise imself, and put on different clothes, and e go, and two men with am, and dem come to di woman by night. E talk say, “Divine to me, I beg you, by di familiar spirit, and bring up for me whoever I go name to you.”
Di woman talk to am say, “Look, you know wetin Saul don do, how e don cut off di mediums and di wizards out of di land. Why den you dey lay one snare for my life, to cause me to die?”
Saul swear to am by di Lord say, “As di Lord live, no punishment go happen to you for dis thing.”
Den di woman talk say, “Who make I bring up to you?” E talk say, “Bring up Samuel for me.”
When di woman see Samuel, e cry with one loud voice, and di woman speak to Saul say, “Why you don deceive me? Because you na Saul.”
Di king talk to am say, “No fear. Wetin you see?” Di woman talk to Saul say, “I see one god wey dey come up out of di earth.”
E talk to am say, “Wetin e look like?” E talk say, “One old man dey come up, and e dey covered with one robe.” Saul know say na Samuel, and e bow with im face to di ground, and make homage.

Samuel talk to Saul say, “Why you don disturb me, to bring me up?” Saul answer say, “I dey in great distress, because di Philistines dey make war against me, and God don depart from me, and no answer me again, either by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I don call you, so that you go make known to me wetin I go do.”
Samuel talk say, “Why den you ask me, seeing say di Lord don depart from you, and don become your adversary?
Di Lord don do to you, as e talk by me. Di Lord don tear di kingdom out of your hand, and give am to your neighbour, even to David.
Because you no obey di voice of di Lord, and no execute im fierce wrath upon Amalek, so di Lord don do dis thing to you dis day.

Moreover di Lord go deliver Israel with you into di hand of di Philistines, and tomorrow you and your pikin man dem go dey with me. Di Lord go also deliver di army of Israel into di hand of di Philistines.”
Den Saul fall straightaway full length upon di earth, and dey very afraid, because of di words of Samuel. Strength no dey for am too, because e no eat any food all di day, or all di night.
Di woman come to Saul, and see say e dey very troubled, and talk to am say, “Look, your servant don obey your voice, and I don put my life for my hand, and don listen to di words wey you talk to me.
Now therefore, I beg you, listen also to di voice of your servant, and make I set one morsel of bread before you, and eat, so that you go get strength, when you go on your way.”
But e refuse, and talk say, “I no go eat.” But im servants, together with di woman, urge am, and e listen to dem voice. So e arise from di earth, and sit upon di bed.
Di woman get one fattened calf for di house, and e hurry, and kill am, and e take flour, and knead am, and bake unleavened bread from am.
E bring am before Saul, and before im servants, and dem eat. Den dem rise up, and go away dat night.
Now di Philistines gather together all dem armies to Aphek, and Israel camp by di spring wey dey for Jezreel.
Di princes of di Philistines dey pass on by hundreds, and by thousands, and David and im men dey pass on for di rear with Achish.

Den di princes of di Philistines talk say, “Wetin dem Hebrews dey do here?” Achish talk to di princes of di Philistines say, “Dis no be David, di servant of Saul di king of Israel, wey don dey with me dem days, or dem years, and I no find any fault for am since di day wey e fall to me until today?”

But di princes of di Philistines dey angry with am, and di princes of di Philistines talk to am say, “Make dis man return, so e go go back to im place wia you don appoint am, and make e no go down with us to battle, so that for di battle e no go become our adversary. Because wetin man go use reconcile imself to im oga? E no go be with di heads of dis men?
Dis no be David, of whom dem sing to one another for dances, talk say, ‘Saul don strike im thousands, and David im ten thousands’?”

Den Achish call David, and talk to am say, “As di Lord live, you don dey upright, and your going out and your coming in with me for di army dey good for my sight, because I no find evil for you since di day of your coming to me until today. Nevertheless di princes no favour you.
Therefore now return, and go in peace, so that you no displease di princes of di Philistines.”
David talk to Achish say, “But wetin I don do? And wetin you don find for your servant so long as I don dey before you until today, say I no go go fight against di enemies of my oga di king?”
Achish answer David say, “I know say you dey good for my sight, like angel of God. Notwithstanding di princes of di Philistines don talk say, ‘E no go go up with us to di battle.’
Therefore rise up early for di morning with di servants of your oga wey don come with you. When una don rise up early for di morning, and get light, depart.”
So David rise up early, e and im men, to depart for di morning, to return into di land of di Philistines. Di Philistines go up to Jezreel.
E happen, when David and im men come to Ziklag on di third day, say di Amalekites don invade di South, and Ziklag, and don strike Ziklag, and burn am with fire,
and don carry di women and all wey dey dere captive, both small and great. Dem no kill any, but carry dem away, and go dem way.
When David and im men come to di city, look, e burn with fire, and dem wives, and dem pikin man dem, and dem pikin woman dem, dem don carry captive.
Den David and di people wey dey with am lift up dem voice and weep, until dem no get power to weep again.
David two wives dem also carry captive, Ahinoam di Jezreelitess, and Abigail di wife of Nabal di Carmelite.

David dey greatly distressed, because di people talk of stoning am, because di soul of all di people dey grieved, every man for im pikin man dem and for im pikin woman dem. But David strengthen imself for di Lord im God.
David talk to Abiathar di priest, di pikin of Ahimelech, say, “Bring me here di ephod, I beg you.” Abiathar bring di ephod to David.
David enquire of di Lord say, “I go pursue dis troop? I go overtake dem?” E answer am say, “Pursue, because you go surely overtake dem, and go surely recover all.”
So David go, e and di 600 men wey dey with am, and come to di brook Besor, wia di rest stay behind.
But David pursue, e and 400 men, because 200 stay behind, wey dey too faint to cross di brook Besor.
Dem find one Egyptian for di field, and bring am to David, and give am bread, and e eat, and dem make am drink water.
Dem give am one piece of cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins. When e don eat, im spirit come again to am, because e no eat bread, or drink water, three days and three nights.
David talk to am say, “Who you belong to? And wia you come from?” E talk say, “I na young man of Egypt, servant to one Amalekite, and my oga leave me, because three days ago I fall sick.
We invade di South of di Cherethites, and di territory wey belong to Judah, and di South of Caleb, and we burn Ziklag with fire.”
David talk to am say, “You go bring me down to dis troop?” E talk say, “Swear to me by God, say you no go kill me, or deliver me up into di hand of my oga, and I go bring you down to dis troop.”

When e bring am down, look, dem dey spread abroad over all di ground, eating and drinking and dancing, because of all di great plunder wey dem don take out of di land of di Philistines, and out of di land of Judah.
David strike dem from di twilight even to di evening of di next day, and none of dem escape, except 400 young men, wey ride on camels and flee.
David recover all wey di Amalekites don carry away, and David rescue im two wives.
Nothing lack to dem, small or great, pikin man or pikin woman, plunder, or anything wey dem don take for dem. David bring back all.
David take all di flocks and di herds, and dem drive dem before di other livestock, and dem talk say, “Dis na David plunder.”

David come to di 200 men, wey dey too faint to follow David, wey dem tell make dem stay behind for di brook Besor, and dem go out to meet David, and to meet di people wey dey with am. When David come near to di people, e greet dem.

Den all di wicked men among dem wey go with David answer and talk say, “Because dem no go with us, we no go give dem anything of di plunder wey we don recover, except to every man im wife and im pikin dem, so make dem lead dem away, and go.”
Den David talk say, “No do so, my brothers, with wetin di Lord don give us, wey don preserve us, and deliver di troop wey come against us into our hand.
Who go listen to una for dis matter? Because as im part dey wey go down to di battle, so im part go dey wey stay by di baggage. Dem go share alike.”
E don be so from dat day forward, say e make am one statute and one ordinance for Israel to dis day.
When David come to Ziklag, e send of di plunder to di elders of Judah, even to im friends, talk say, “Look, one present for una of di plunder of di enemies of di Lord.”
E send to dem wey dey Bethel, and to dem wey dey Ramoth of di South, and to dem wey dey Jattir,
and to dem wey dey Aroer, and to dem wey dey Siphmoth, and to dem wey dey Eshtemoa,
and to dem wey dey Racal, and to dem wey dey di cities of di Jerahmeelites, and to dem wey dey di cities of di Kenites,
and to dem wey dey Hormah, and to dem wey dey Bor Ashan, and to dem wey dey Athach,
and to dem wey dey Hebron, and to all di places wia David imself and im men dey waka go.
Now di Philistines fight against Israel, and di men of Israel flee from before di Philistines, and fall down slain for mount Gilboa.
Di Philistines overtake Saul and im pikin man dem, and di Philistines kill Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, Saul pikin man dem.
Di battle go sore against Saul, and di archers overtake am, and e dey greatly distressed because of di archers.

Den Saul talk to im armour bearer say, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with am, so that dis uncircumcised no go come and thrust me through, and abuse me.” But im armour bearer no want, because e fear plenty. So Saul take im sword, and fall on am.
When im armour bearer see say Saul don die, e also fall on im sword, and die with am.
So Saul die, and im three pikin man dem, and im armour bearer, and all im men, dat same day together.

When di men of Israel wey dey for di other side of di valley, and dem wey dey for di other side of di Jordan, see say di men of Israel flee, and say Saul and im pikin man dem don die, dem abandon di cities, and flee, and di Philistines come and dwell for dem.
E happen on di next day, when di Philistines come to strip di slain, say dem find Saul and im three pikin man dem fall for mount Gilboa.
Dem cut off im head, and strip off im armour, and send into di land of di Philistines round about, to carry di news to di house of dem idols, and to di people.
Dem put im armour for di house of Ashtaroth, and dem fasten im body to di wall of Beth Shan.
When di people of Jabesh Gilead hear wetin di Philistines don do to Saul,
all di valiant men arise, and go all night, and take di body of Saul and di bodies of im pikin man dem from di wall of Beth Shan, and dem come to Jabesh, and burn dem dere.
Dem take dem bones, and bury dem under di tamarisk tree for Jabesh, and fast seven days.
